name: Facade weathering rules
about: Numeric rules for building weathering, measured in facade space (metres) on a darkening map D = 1 - Y_weathered / Y_clean. A configuration is accepted only when every binding rule passes. Origins: U = the user's review notes (review 36), P = measured on the reference photos, L = building physics and the soiling literature, C = craft estimate (to recalibrate with picks).

definitions.D: darkening of albedo luminance against the same surface with no weathering: 0 clean, 0.10 = 10 % darker, negative = lighter

tiers.note: each tier is about 1.6-2x the one below; T1 is near the threshold of seeing on a pale wall (about 1 L*), T4 is a clear stain, T6 a black crust

levels.below: under 12.5 cm is the material's own texture (grain, pores, coat bumps): the material set and the tiling detail, checked by J rules on close crops

clock.note: a building is on average two-thirds of the way through its repaint cycle, and 17 % of the dirt survives each repaint. Round H: rounds F and G both had the user pick the next-cleaner preset as the 35-year default; the old clock (the cycle's end, 22 % kept) made every age one level too weathered. Damage, cracks, rust, efflorescence, edges and fading follow age, not E

definitions.planes: exposed painted faces visible in elevation: front plane (parapets, slab edges), the walls above the parapets, end walls (gables), the plinth; soffits and recesses are sheltered planes
definitions.D_local: the weathering's own local contrast: D_local = 1 - (1 - D) / ref, ref = the least weathered 10 cm patch within +-1 m (smoothed), on 4 cm block means. A uniform darkening of a whole wall gives 0 (it reads as a paint colour, not as weathering: the user, review 36); paint tones that differ from element to element do not count either. T1 is below photo noise and material texture, so the amount rules start at T2. Arris rows and the edge layer's pixels are left out (the edge rules N1-N5 measure them), and so are the peeling layer's (P1-P3 measure them).

kept.label: Kept
kept.anchor: U (round G): 'something between New and Kept, which will become the new kept'

typical.label: Typical (default)
typical.anchor: U (round G): round G's Kept picked as the default street block on the front and at 1:1; 'the current Kept becomes Typical'

derelict.label: Derelict
derelict.anchor: U (round G): 'Worn currently is probably more like derelict levels of weathering... Worn becomes Derelict'

coverage.about: A1: share of the exposed painted wall at or above each tier of D_local (T2+ ... T6+), by preset; interpolate in E. Anchors: U, round-7 'Light' (picked for a moderately kept block) measured T3+ 0.16, T4+ 0.057, T5+ 0.025; P, ordinary photo walls median T3+ 0.52, T4+ 0.09, T5+ 0.034 (range 0.08-0.66, 0.05-0.25, 0.02-0.12), heavily stained walls T3+ 0.88-0.98, T4+ 0.63-0.96; U, round-7 Neglected (0.49, 0.24, 0.087) was 'not heavy enough'. The New band allows the material's own variation. Round F: re-measured with D_local on the weathering alone; round-7 'Light' then reads 0.35 / 0.13 / 0.041 / 0.011 / 0.001 (inside Kept), round-7 'Medium' 0.64 / 0.44 / 0.17 / 0.039 / 0.004 (Worn's T5+ and T6+ lower bounds moved to 0.035 and 0.004 to hold it), round-7 Neglected 0.76 / 0.52 / 0.25 / 0.072 / 0.011 (still below Neglected: 'not heavy enough'). Round G: the user picked the Kept image as the default street block (35 years, upkeep 0.9) on the front and on the 1:1 top floors, so Typical takes Kept's round-F bands; Kept is about 0.6x; Worn between Typical and Neglected; Neglected unchanged ('about right'). Round H: as the tone, the presets moved onto these anchors through the clock (the user's rename); the bands did not change. Round I: an explicit Kept anchor (E 5.56) with lighter dark tiers (T4+ 0.004-0.030, T5+ 0.001-0.010, T6+ <= 0.003; the user: Kept 'a tiny bit too dirty, namely the darker stains look a little too dark'), and Derelict (E 19.8) raised to T2+ 0.50-0.85, T3+ 0.28-0.55, T4+ 0.10-0.26, T5+ 0.03-0.10, T6+ 0.006-0.04 ('Still looks too light ... the amount or spread of wear/weather/organic growth/damage').

rules.title: Overall greying follows age and upkeep
rules.measure: mean D against clean on all exposed painted planes (area-weighted)
rules.pass: inside the 'tone' band at the config's E
rules.origin: U+C

rules.title: Marks cover more of the wall, at more intensities, with age and neglect
rules.measure: share of exposed painted wall at each tier of D_local (T2+ ... T6+), area-weighted
rules.pass: every tier inside its 'coverage' band at the config's E
rules.origin: U+P

rules.title: No clean sections
rules.measure: D_local cell means on 4 m cells (S3) per plane
rules.pass: P10 cell >= 0.30 x mean, and min cell >= 0.15 x mean, when E >= 10; >= 0.40 / 0.25 when E >= 25
rules.origin: U ('that middle section has virtually no wear or stain')

rules.title: Edges carry weathering too
rules.measure: mean D_local in the outer 1 m bands of each plane (both vertical ends, and the 1 m under the wall top) over the plane mean
rules.origin: U ('the edge areas also have no staining')

rules.title: Presets order at every tier
rules.measure: composite tier coverage across the presets new < kept < typical < worn < derelict; and the ground band: base excess (bottom 1 m over the wall mean, minus 1) per preset, as steps over its New-to-Derelict range
rules.pass: strictly increasing at T1+..T5+ (ties allowed only where both are below 0.001); ground band steps <= 0.45 of the range, the New-to-Kept step <= 0.30
rules.origin: C; U (round F: 'the jumps between the steps for the ground level could be more subtle')

rules.title: Seeds of a preset read as the same age
rules.measure: the seeds of one preset: tone (A0), T3+ and T4+ of D_local, and the film contrast the solver used
rules.pass: each within its tolerance of the seeds' mean: tone 4 %, T3+ 7 %, T4+ 8 %, film contrast 2 %
rules.origin: U (round G: 'Seed 1 looks stronger, 2 and 3 look a little closer'; seed 1 measured T3+ 0.205 and T4+ 0.086 against 0.185-0.191 and 0.071-0.079, film contrast 0.69 against 0.61 and 0.50)

rules.title: The presets step evenly
rules.measure: tone (A0) steps from New up the preset ladder
rules.pass: largest step over the smallest <= 2.2, every step > 0
rules.origin: U (round G: 'Yes, even steps' for a ladder measuring 1.9); C (the margin)

rules.title: A range of opacities, more faint than heavy while the wall is kept
rules.measure: shares of the exposed painted wall in each D_local tier band T2..T6
rules.pass: when E >= 10: at least 4 tiers each hold >= 1 % of the wall, and no tier holds more than 60 % of the stained area (T2+), 70 % when E < 12; when 10 <= E <= 20 the share falls from T3 upward (each ratio <= 0.9)
rules.origin: U ('It's also levels like opacities and concentrations'); P (heavy photo walls shift to the dark tiers, so the falling rule stops at E 20)

rules.title: Large marks have an inner pattern
rules.measure: connected marks of D_local >= T3 with equivalent diameter >= 0.5 m: coefficient of variation of D_local inside, and the number of tiers spanned
rules.pass: median CV >= 0.30 and >= 60 % of them span >= 3 tiers (reach T5); marks >= 2 m: median CV >= 0.40, 10th percentile >= 0.33, none under 0.25 (when E >= 25: 0.33, 0.25, 0.20)
rules.origin: U ('large blotches need inner patterns and varying intensity'); P (recalibrated on D_local of the photo walls, round F: ordinary walls 9 of 14 marks >= 0.5 m span >= 3 tiers, median CV about 0.35, marks >= 2 m CV 0.35-0.68; heavy walls 0.25-0.58)

rules.title: No flat tint
rules.measure: share of the stained footprint (D >= T1) whose local std over 20 cm is below 0.005
rules.pass: <= 0.05 for the composite and for the soiling layer
rules.origin: U ('looks like you're just changing the base color'); P (photos: 0.00)

rules.title: Energy at every scale level
rules.measure: std of the composite's difference-of-Gaussian band per level (S2-S8 that fit the plane)
rules.pass: every level >= 0.004 when E >= 10, and max/min over S3-S8 <= 3.0
rules.origin: U ('micro, mid, and macro... EIGHT levels of scale'); P (photo walls: flat to rising band std, max/min 1.3-2.6)

rules.title: Each areal layer spans macro, mid and micro
rules.measure: per layer (soiling, stains, base, bio): levels whose band std >= 15 % of the layer's largest band
rules.pass: at least one level in each group (macro, mid, micro) and >= 5 levels in all
rules.origin: U

rules.title: More small marks than large
rules.measure: count of connected marks per level at D >= T2, per layer (streaks, stains, bio, damage)
rules.pass: count(S_k+1) >= 1.5 x count(S_k) for every level k with count >= 10, down to S7
rules.origin: C (power-law sizes)

rules.title: 80/20 at several scales, with a background
rules.measure: share of the summed D_local held by the top 20 % of cells, on 4 m and 2 m cells, per plane; streak and stain layers on their own maps
rules.pass: composite in [0.28, 0.60]; streak and stain layers in [0.40, 0.85] on planes where the layer covers >= 3 % at T2+
rules.origin: U ('the 80/20 applies at various levels, and it isn't necessarily as simple as on/off'); P (photo walls 0.26-0.35 on 1 m cells against a local reference)

rules.title: Variety without jumping all over
rules.measure: per storey-bay cells of D_local on each plane, storeys only (the roof parapet or coping band above the top slab and the ground storey's splash zone are systematic and have their own rules, A3/F1 and F3): lag-1 correlation of neighbours (storey to storey, bay to bay), and the P90 of the storey-to-storey difference over the P90-P10 spread; bay to bay compares neighbouring bays of the same kind (unit next to unit)
rules.pass: rho floor-to-floor >= 0.30, rho bay-to-bay >= 0.20, jump <= 0.80
rules.origin: U ('too much of a difference between that upper floor and the one immediately under it'); P (photos: rho 0.1-0.9, jump 0.3-0.8)

rules.title: Top more intense than the middle
rules.measure: mean D of the streak + stain layers in the top 20 % of each wall's height over the 30-70 % band
rules.origin: U ('I'd expect the ones near the top to be more intense'); L (driven rain peaks at the top); P (photo walls median 1.4)

rules.title: Each run is darkest at its source
rules.measure: streak and stain marks taller than 0.5 m: mean D of the top third over the bottom third
rules.pass: median >= 1.25
rules.origin: L (run-off deposits most near its source); U

rules.title: Darker base
rules.measure: mean D of the dirt (damage, cracks, crack repairs and edges left out) in the bottom 1 m of each wall over the wall mean
rules.origin: P (photo walls 1.3-2.0); L (splash, damp, soil); U (round F: the ground band should come in gently)

rules.title: North and damp faces grow more
rules.measure: bio layer coverage at T2+ on north-facing planes over south-facing
rules.pass: >= 1.5 when bio is present
rules.origin: L

rules.title: Streaks start at a feature
rules.measure: share of streak marks whose top lies within 0.15 m below a source pixel (ledge and slab drip line, the drip edge under copings and roof props, horizontal joints and grooves, joint crossings, sill end, opening corner, fixing, joint, chip, top edge)
rules.origin: P (review 31: every streak in 17 photos starts at a feature); L; U (round I: 'coming down from the horizontal grooves')

rules.title: Stains are dark on every material
rules.measure: on dark substrates (plinth, bare concrete; clean Y < 0.30): share of pixels lighter than the clean surface by more than T2, and lightening marks taller than 0.3 m
rules.pass: <= 0.02 and none; passes when the building has no dark substrate
rules.origin: U ('I'd expect stains to be dark somewhat independently of the materials')

rules.title: Lightening is rare and specific
rules.measure: share of each plane lighter than clean by more than T1 (washed, worn, efflorescence, fading, repaint)
rules.pass: <= 0.25 x the plane's share at T1+ darkening
rules.origin: C; L (white washing is a late-life feature, 2 of 23 photos)

rules.title: Algae sits where water stays
rules.measure: share of the algae layer's darkening in the wet zone: the bottom 1.5 m, within 0.8 m below a water source (tops, sill ends, corner heads, fixings, joints, stain and streak marks), or in a joint
rules.pass: >= 60 % wherever algae covers >= 0.2 % of a plane at T2+
rules.origin: U ('growth and algae/mold stains from the water'); L (algae needs standing or running water; it starts at the foot, under drips and in joints)

rules.title: Seam crossings collect a little more
rules.measure: where a horizontal and a vertical joint cross: mean D on the joint pixels within 4 cm of the crossing over the joint pixels 0.2-0.6 m from it, per plane
rules.pass: in [1.15, 2.0] wherever the streak amount is 0.2 or more
rules.origin: U (round F: 'the intersecting corners where seams cross could use a little more. Just a tiny adjustment, don't overdo it'); L (water meets and pauses where joints cross); round F measured 1.02-1.07

rules.title: No accidental lattice
rules.measure: per plane, axis and map (soiling, stains, streaks, base, growth, D) on painted wall: the edge-energy profile's periodogram over its running median; the harmonic sum over the first 8 harmonics for periods of 16-600 px, the building's own rhythm (floor pitch, twice it, bay pitch, the 1.8 m scaffold lift, the peaks of the wall's feature map with its joints) left out; a layer is scanned on an axis only where it spans a third of it
rules.pass: the largest harmonic sum <= 9
rules.origin: U (round F: the grime reads as a grid); docs/redesign/research/weathering-grid-breakup.md 5.1-5.2 (tile-free controls 4.0-7.9; round F's soiling 12.8 from the 3.6 m material tile; measured here 13.5-26 on round F's fronts)

rules.title: The wall is not striped
rules.measure: composite anisotropy gx/gy of the S5-S8 bands
rules.origin: P (photo walls 0.5-1.6; round-7 renders 2.6-4.0)

rules.title: Streaks read as streaks, stains as stains
rules.measure: anisotropy of the streak layer's S7-S8 bands; of the stain layer's S4-S6 bands
rules.pass: streaks >= 2.0; stains in [0.5, 2.0]
rules.origin: U ('the big blotches blend a little too well with the long streaks'); C, calibrated on synthetic marks: a single 1 m x 3 cm streak measures 1.69 / 2.34 / 3.23 at S6 / S7 / S8, a 0.4 m drip 1.14 / 1.51 / 2.13, a fringe of drips 0.43 / 0.80 / 1.29, stains about 1.5

rules.title: Streak cores show through stains
rules.measure: where streak cores (streak layer >= T3) lie inside stains (stain layer >= T2): composite D at the core minus the mean over a 15-30 cm ring
rules.pass: median >= 0.03
rules.origin: U

rules.title: Long streaks, some near the whole height
rules.measure: per wall of 3 storeys or more: the longest vertical run of the streak layer at T2+ (gaps under 0.6 m bridged: slabs, windows) as a share of the wall height; distinct runs of 3 m or more per 25 m of width
rules.pass: reach >= 0.35 + 0.40 x the streak amount; runs >= 1 + 3.5 x the amount per 25 m; from amount 0.25
rules.origin: U (round F: 'more long vertical streaks', 'some near-whole building long streaks', 'some areas channel water more than others'); round F reached 0.22-0.61 of the wall with 0.6-3.6 runs per 25 m

rules.title: Some streaks much darker (layering)
rules.measure: streak-layer marks 0.3 m tall or more: the 90th percentile of their mean D over the median
rules.pass: >= 1.8 (20 marks or more, from amount 0.25)
rules.origin: U (round F: 'get darker (just some of them, not all, remember layering)'); round F measured 1.41-1.47; C (1.8)

rules.title: Streaks gather in the vertical lines
rules.measure: streak pixels at T2+ on paint: the share within 0.3 m of a vertical joint, a bay division or a wall's end (from streak amount 0.15)
rules.origin: U (round H: 'streaking will probably be most severe along the panel lines going down. They're natural channels where water gathers'); L (research weathering-water-layers V3; PCI: vertical recesses gather run-off)

rules.title: Dirt shifts colour like real dirt
rules.measure: soiling, streak and stain pixels at T3+ against clean: shift in b* (yellow-blue) and |a*| per 0.1 of D (bio and rust exempt)
rules.pass: b* shift in [-0.30, +0.80] per 0.1 D and |a*| <= 1.0 per 0.1 D
rules.origin: P (photo stains on painted walls: b* -0.26 to +0.67 and a* -0.9 to +0.2 per 0.1 D; a grey multiply gives about -0.16)

rules.title: More kinds of discolouration with neglect
rules.measure: number of layers covering >= 0.3 % of the wall at T2+ (or, for lightening layers, lighter than T1)
rules.pass: >= 3 at E >= 10, >= 5 at E >= 19, >= 7 at E >= 25 (soiling, streaks, stains, base, bio, rust, efflorescence, washed, fading, repaint, peeling, cracks)
rules.origin: U ('more varied wear, discoloration beyond just staining, growth and algae/mold stains')

rules.title: Weathering varies in colour like the reference walls
rules.measure: weathered pixels (D_local >= T3 on 4 cm blocks, growth and rust left out) on painted wall: the spread of their Lab shift against clean, the share shifted by 1.5 or more, and the spread between marks of 0.5 m or more, per wall; from E 10
rules.pass: spread 0.9-4.0; non-neutral share 0.12-0.80; mark-to-mark spread >= 0.2 where there are three marks or more
rules.origin: U (round F: more colour variety, calibrated on the photos); P (five ordinary photo walls: spread 1.2-3.9 over a clean-wall noise of 0.65-0.99, so 1.0-3.8 above noise; non-neutral 0.21-0.75 over a noise of 0-0.13; marks 0.2-0.84); round F's builds 0.24-0.89

rules.title: Organic marks at different stages sit side by side
rules.measure: growth pixels on paint (growth at T1+) against clean, by the hue of their shift: the yellow stage (60-100 deg, b* +3 or more), the green stage (100-180 deg, a* -1 or less), the red-muddy stage (15-60 deg, a* +1.5 or more); from E 8
rules.pass: yellow and green each >= 5 %; from E 18 the red-muddy stage too
rules.origin: U (round H: 'keep it on a continuum, dark yellow to dark green to reddish/muddy'; round G: 'Not blended smoothly, but coexisting'); L (research weathering-water-layers: yellow first, green, then brown-black; red only with Trentepohlia)

rules.title: A place's organic colour only moves forward
rules.measure: between successive presets, the pixels with growth in both, staged as in I4: the share that goes back a stage; and the growth pixels' mean L* shift
rules.pass: 8 % or fewer go back; from each preset at E 8 or more to the next, the mean L* shift falls by 1.0 or more
rules.origin: U (round H: 'the colors of the organic staining are flipping between levels ... a streak that looks dark gray, then turns yellow, then blackish'; round G: 'mold and mildew darken/intensify with age')

rules.title: Water and dirt marks keep the dirt palette
rules.measure: streak, stain and ground-band pixels at T2+ on paint, growth and rust left out: the share in the green stage (as I4)
rules.origin: U (round H: 'make sure that the pure water staining isn't necessarily the same layer as the organic staining ... one is a growth from the other. Layering, remember layering')

rules.title: The material is not uniform or smooth
rules.measure: the clean material at the two resolutions the asset carries: relative std of the luminance band-pass at 10-50 cm and 0.5-2 m on each plane's clean albedo (50 px/m, the baked atlas), and at 0.5-2 cm and 2-10 cm on 1 m close-ups at 1 mm/px under the preview light (the coat set as the shader samples it); relief: RMS slope of the close-up height at 1-10 mm
rules.pass: each band in [1.2 %, 5 %] on every plane and close-up; relief RMS slope >= 2 degrees
rules.origin: U ('Concrete isn't uniform like this. And it's not smooth like this'); P (round E photo walls 1.9-3.6 %)

rules.title: Weathering follows the material
rules.measure: (a) correlation of the soiling layer with the material response (coat strength, laps, coat thickness, joints) in the 4-50 cm band on the painted walls; (b) mean soiling in the joints over the wall within 15 cm of them; (c) on each close-up, mean soiling in the deepest 20 % of the coat's cavities over the shallowest 50 %
rules.pass: (a) >= 0.25 pixel-weighted over the planes, (b) >= 1.3 where joints exist and E >= 10, (c) >= 1.3; when E >= 5
rules.origin: U ('the basic texture of the material... also informs the wear and tearing patterns, stains and streaks, biological growth...')

rules.title: Damage at many sizes, more levels with more damage
rules.measure: damage marks (chips, spalls) counted per level S4-S8 and below
rules.pass: the largest damage level present reaches S8 at amount 0.25, S7 at 0.5, S6 at 0.75, S5 at 1.0; from that level down to S8 the geometric mean count ratio per level is in [2, 6] and no step is below 1.3 (levels with >= 3 marks)
rules.origin: U ('micro, mid, and macro levels... EIGHT levels of scale')

rules.title: Each step of the damage control shows
rules.measure: damaged area and count between amount steps of 0.25
rules.pass: area x >= 1.6 and count x >= 1.5 per step
rules.origin: U ('they all look of a similar size of breaking, same distribution, and same overall amount')

rules.title: Edges first, clustered around a centre
rules.measure: share of chips centred within 10 cm of an exposed edge; share of chip area inside hotspot clusters (the rest is background chipping); chip size against distance from its hotspot centre, within each hotspot (median over hotspots with 6 or more satellites) (edge-damage clusters and background chips; delamination spalls follow K5 and K6)
rules.origin: L; U (round B: damage radiates from a centre)

rules.title: Breaks are sharp, rough and recessed
rules.measure: on the break coverage map, radial profiles (16 rays) across the outline of every break of 3 px radius or more, plane cuts left out: the width of the 0.9 to 0.1 ramp; inside breaks of 4 cm radius and up, the relative std of the albedo's 1.5 px high-pass; their median depth
rules.pass: median ramp <= 2 px (4 cm at 50 px/m); texture >= 0.035; depth 0.8-4.5 cm
rules.origin: L (a fracture edge is sharp at millimetre scale; a spall goes to the cover concrete, 2-4 cm, and shows aggregate); lead review, round F: at amount 0.75 the large breaks read as soft smudges (ramp 4.25 px, no depth)

rules.title: Spalled area by amount
rules.measure: share of the wall (paint and concrete) under a break (coverage >= 0.5)
rules.origin: U (round F: derelict at 1.0); L (docs/redesign/research/weathering-cracks-edges-damage.md S1: 3.7-9.9 % at 75 years unmaintained); round F reached 0.54 % at 1.0

rules.title: Spalls start at edges
rules.measure: spalls 30 mm across or more: share within 150 mm of an arris
rules.origin: L (docs/redesign/research/weathering-cracks-edges-damage.md S5: corners, slab noses, sills, parapet tops)

rules.title: Cracks from hairline to pattern cracks
rules.measure: crack length per m2 of wall (width >= 0.05 mm), of cracks >= 0.3 mm, and the median width, pooled over exposed walls
rules.origin: U (round F: 'cracks from hairline to pattern cracks'); L (docs/redesign/research/weathering-cracks-edges-damage.md C1, C2, C4); round F had about 0 m per m2 (no opening corners reached the crack layer)

rules.title: Cracks run mostly vertical
rules.measure: length-weighted crack orientation, pattern cracks left out
rules.pass: vertical 40-65 %, diagonal 20-40 %, horizontal 10-25 %
rules.origin: L (docs/redesign/research/weathering-cracks-edges-damage.md C7)

rules.title: Diagonal cracks start at opening corners
rules.measure: share of diagonal crack length within one opening width of an opening corner
rules.origin: L (docs/redesign/research/weathering-cracks-edges-damage.md C8: 45 deg cracks from window corners)

rules.title: Cracks read through what they carry
rules.measure: median delta L* of the 1 px crack line against the wall around it, by width class (repaired cracks left out)
rules.origin: L (docs/redesign/research/weathering-cracks-edges-damage.md C19 and 3.1: at 20 mm/px a crack shows through its halo, not its opening)

rules.title: Repaired cracks
rules.measure: share of the length of cracks >= 0.3 mm under a repair stripe
rules.origin: L (docs/redesign/research/weathering-cracks-edges-damage.md C23: U-cut and injected repairs on repainted danchi)

rules.title: A control widens coverage, not only opacity
rules.measure: per detail control, between sweep steps of 0.25: the layer's coverage at T2+ and at its top tier
rules.pass: each step widens the layer's coverage by >= 1.25x at its intensity frontier, the lowest tier covering under half the wall at the step below; and the intensity rises at least once per two steps: the top tier reached moves up, the frontier moves up, or the share of the layer's area at T4+ grows by >= 10 % (not for damage or rust: breaks and rust on the steel are full contrast at any amount; K2 and R2 check their steps). A step 'has some' of a layer at 0.2 % of the wall, or for damage at any break area: breaks are discrete
rules.origin: U ('The intensity should not only increase the opacity, but also the amount of surface covered by various levels of intensity')

rules.title: Each step is visible
rules.measure: between sweep steps: share of the plane where |delta D| >= 0.01, and mean |delta D| there
rules.pass: each step changes >= 2 % of a plane by >= 0.01 (or half the layer's own T2+ area if that is smaller), with a mean change >= 0.02
rules.origin: U ('I can't see a difference')

rules.title: Each step of a control looks as big as the last
rules.measure: per detail control over its steps above 0 (not damage, which K2 checks): the ratio between steps of the layer's mean D, and of its coverage at the frontier tier (the lowest tier under half the wall at the first step shown), while that coverage is under half the wall
rules.pass: largest ratio over smallest: <= 1.5 for the mean, <= 1.4 for the coverage
rules.origin: U (round F: stains 'the jump to 0.5 is pretty strong, but the jump to 0.75 and 1 feel smaller'; grime 'maybe 0.4 to 0.5 the jump is smaller than 0.3 to 0.4'); round F's stain sweep measured 1.88 and 1.71

rules.title: The control's top step is strong
rules.measure: at a sweep's last step (1.0): the layer's share of the exposed walls at T2+ and at T4+
rules.pass: streaks: >= 0.035 at T2+ and >= 0.012 at T4+
rules.origin: U (round F: 'Even the last is too weak... 1.00/100% should be more intense'); round F's 1.0 measured 0.023 and 0.008

rules.title: Marks grow in area with age
rules.measure: over the presets from Kept: the streak area at T2+ (m2) and the ground band's median height (the highest row of the ground-band layer at T1+, per column)
rules.pass: each step: streak area x 1.15 or more, the ground band 5 cm or more higher
rules.origin: U (round H: 'the increases in ... streaking and ground level wear/staining aren't expanding/increase size and surface area ... the bottom level dirt is getting more intense, but not really seeing a whole lot more of it'); L (research weathering-water-layers V4: x 1.3-1.6 area per step)

rules.title: Light growth is a tint, not grey

rules.origin: U (round J: 'needs more horizontal rusting on the horizontal rails'; 'the horizontal railing needs more horizontal rusting growth between steps'; 'The top would probably advance more with advanced wearing'); L (docs/redesign/research/member-rust-and-geometry-aware-wear.md §1.4: rails grow by new failures along the wet lines beside each joint, the underside and lower arris first, then up the front face; the top face has the thickest film and is rain-washed); C (the research's lower-arris bands 8-20 / 30-50 / 60-80 / >= 90 %, raised at 0.25 and 0.5 because the drip-line row at 50 px/m is 2 cm, not 8 mm)

rules.title: Dense dark scale carries a rough sheen, in the material
rules.measure: railing steel's rust (as R1, panels left out): the sheen mask (alpha >= 0.5; exported as M_hi.A on steel) as a share of it; the share of the sheen in the dark class (albedo L* <= 32) and at the wet parts (feet, joints, the bottom rail, the rails' upper rows); the share of rusted steel whose albedo has b* < 0
rules.pass: none below rust 0.5 (<= 0.1 %); <= 4 % at 0.55, 2-8 % at 0.75, 4-15 % at 1.0 (linear between); >= 90 % of it dark and >= 60 % at the wet parts (50 sheen pixels or more); <= 0.5 % of rusted steel with b* < 0. The sheen is the material's: F0 0.04 -> 0.08 (UE Specular 0.5 -> 1.0; Godot SPECULAR 0.5 -> 0.71) and roughness -> 0.55 under the mask, never blue in the albedo
rules.origin: U (after round J: 'look into some subtle touches of blue rusting on the rust ... some parts actually develop a rough blue sheen on the darker rust surfaces. Although that may be better off as a material shader in unreal or whatever game engine inherits these'); L (docs/redesign/research/rust-blue-sheen.md §1-2: compact goethite, magnetite and hematite reflect 13-31 % at normal incidence against about 4 % for paint and loose rust, so dense scale mirrors the blue sky; magnetite forms under thick, wet rust); I (§5: split-sum sky arithmetic); P (the note's photo references); C (shares)

rules.title: Flakes and breaks stay on their surface
rules.measure: pixel pairs across a depth step of 3 cm or more on painted wall (4-neighbours, both painted, at 50 px/m): how often a flaked pixel's neighbour across the step is flaked (the paint failure's alpha >= 0.3), over how often any pixel beside a step is; the same for breaks (the damage alpha >= 0.5)
rules.pass: the ratio <= 2 for flakes and for breaks (30 flaked or broken pairs or more), or not significantly above it: a ratio over 2 fails when that many coincidences would arise by chance under 1 % of the time at 2x the side's rate (Poisson); independent patterns read about 1, one pattern run across the step far more
rules.origin: U (round J, the 2 m view: 'the same chipping pattern is clearly being applied to the front of the balcony as it is to the wall behind it, even though there's probably 1-2m of distance between them. Makes no sense'); L (docs/redesign/research/member-rust-and-geometry-aware-wear.md §2.1-2.2: pros key patterns to 3D position or the object; a 2D elevation field crosses the 1.2-1.4 m step from a balcony front to the wall behind); I

rules.title: Grooves and their lips are respected
rules.measure: the player's view of the north walkway's panel joint at 1 m (1,920 px/m; a 20 mm groove found from the capture depth): the flaked or chipped share of the lips (4 mm outside the groove's edges), the groove floor and the open face (3 cm or more from a groove); the share of the joint's length with a crack along the floor
rules.pass: from Typical: the lips >= 3x the open face (and >= 4 %); the floor <= 0.6x the open face + 2 points; a crack along >= 30 % of the joint at Worn and >= 60 % at Derelict; New and Kept: the crack on <= 10 %
rules.origin: U (round J, the north walkway at arm's length: 'The chipping should respect the channel. It probably wouldn't chip the same way as the raised surface. Either more or less. Also, I'd expect some more chipping along the edges of the channel ... that difference in topology/depth needs to be respected'); L (docs/redesign/research/member-rust-and-geometry-aware-wear.md §2.3: paint pulls back to 50-70 % of the flat film at edges and lips take the knocks, 3-8x the open face's chips; paint over a moving joint cracks along it, 20-40 % of its length at Typical, 50-80 % at Worn, >= 80 % at Derelict); C

tone.about: A0: mean D against clean on the exposed painted walls (the overall greying of the paint), by preset. Origin U: the round-7 'Light' level, 0.24, was picked as right for a moderately maintained block; round-7 Neglected (0.56) was not too dark, it lacked variety. Interpolate in E. Round G: Typical centred on Kept's round-F tone (0.18), since the user picked the Kept image as the 35-year default; Kept about 0.12; Worn about 0.27; Neglected unchanged. Round H: the bands stay on their E anchors; the new clock moves the presets onto them (Typical at 10.75 has round G's Kept look, Worn at 14.5 round G's Typical, Derelict at 19.8 round G's Worn; 27.1 is beyond Derelict, no preset).
